overview.eyebrow: A clearer way through the journey
overview.title: Welcome to Guide Motion
overview.intro: Explore railway station information, passenger services, and the support available to your team.
cards.servicesBody: Food, medical support, and porter services.
cards.teamBody: See the roles and application journey.
heritage.title: A familiar guide, built for every traveller
heritage.body: Guide Motion brings station information and passenger support into one place. Regional languages and accessibility are part of the rebuild from the start.
station.title: Station guide
station.body: Search a sample directory of station facilities by name, location, or category.
station.dataBody: This sample directory and schematic are fictional, not tied to a real station. They do not provide verified directions or live status.
station.mapBody: Select a numbered marker or facility name to connect the sketch with its listing.
station.mapSvgDescription: An illustrative concourse connected to two sample platforms. Numbered controls identify facilities and are listed below.
station.mapHint: Choose a marker or item below.
station.noResults: No facilities match. Try another search or clear the filters.
station.loadError: The sample directory could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
facility.foodCourt.name: Food court
facility.foodCourt.description: A sample listing for a range of meal counters.
facility.foodCourt.accessibility: Open concourse route with step-free access in this example.
facility.teaStall.name: Tea and snacks counter
facility.teaStall.description: A sample listing for a small refreshments counter.
facility.teaStall.accessibility: Platform route; use the sample elevator listing for step-free access.
facility.restrooms.name: Public restrooms
facility.restrooms.description: Illustrative restroom location for the concourse.
facility.restrooms.accessibility: This directory does not verify facility condition or opening status.
facility.waitingRoom.name: Waiting room
facility.waitingRoom.description: A sample waiting space near the central hall.
facility.waitingRoom.accessibility: Lift access is shown as a separate sample listing.
facility.platformSeating.name: Platform seating
facility.platformSeating.description: Example seating markers along a platform.
facility.platformSeating.accessibility: Exact seat positions are not mapped in this prototype.
facility.elevator.name: Elevator
facility.elevator.description: Example lift connection between the concourse and platforms.
facility.elevator.accessibility: Sample location only; lift operation is not monitored.
facility.helpDesk.name: Passenger help desk
facility.helpDesk.description: Illustrative location for general passenger assistance.
facility.helpDesk.accessibility: No live staff availability is shown.
facility.firstAid.name: First aid room
facility.firstAid.location: Main concourse · Beside the help desk
facility.firstAid.description: A sample directory entry for first aid support.
facility.firstAid.accessibility: Not an emergency service. Contact local emergency help if needed.
facility.ticketOffice.name: Ticket office
facility.ticketOffice.description: Example counter location for passenger ticket enquiries.
facility.ticketOffice.accessibility: Hours and ticketing services are not verified.
facility.waterPoint.name: Drinking water point
facility.waterPoint.description: A sample marker for a drinking water point.
facility.waterPoint.accessibility: Availability and water quality are not monitored.
services.title: Passenger services
services.body: Submit a local prototype request for porter, meal, or medical assistance. Requests stay in this browser.
services.demoBody: Use sample details only. Requests stay in this browser on this device, are not sent to railway staff, and do not sync elsewhere. Do not enter real personal or medical information.
services.porterBody: Journey details, luggage, pickup, and drop-off information.
services.mealBody: Meal preference, passenger count, and delivery details.
services.medicalBody: A request form with clear prototype and safety messaging.
bookings.title: My bookings
bookings.body: Requests saved in this browser appear below with their local prototype reference.
bookings.storageBody: These are local prototype records. They are not sent to a railway provider and will not sync to another browser or device.
form.title: Request a service
form.name: Full name *

join.title: Join the team
join.body: Choose a role and send a prototype application. This browser keeps the record locally.
application.demoBody: Use sample details. Applications are saved in this browser, are not sent to an employer, and are visible to anyone using this browser. Do not enter real personal information.
application.title: Apply to join the team

applications.title: Applications
applications.body: Applications saved in this browser are listed below. This is not a private or shared staff system.
applications.localBody: Anyone with access to this browser can view and remove these sample records. No employer can see them.
management.title: Management workspace
management.body: Review booking and staff application records stored locally in this browser.

about.title: About & contact
about.body: The existing project includes an about section, team and testimonial content, and an email-based contact path. These will be reviewed before they are carried into the new UI.
about.reviewBody: Contact details and claims about service availability will be confirmed before publication.
